title: Tracecat 1.5.0-alpha.2.1
body_markdown:
## Case management


- fix(cases): Create a case and its tags in one transaction ([#4155](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4155) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Classify raw provider transport errors as outages ([#4138](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4138) )
- fix(engine+agents): Scope tier and channel-sink reads to their tenant ([#4141](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4141) )
- fix(agents): Allow more than 50 tools on agent chat sessions ([#4012](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4012) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Flush partial NSTUN writes so large uploads don't stall ([#4146](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4146) )


## API


- fix(api): Return 401 for webhook secrets with non-ASCII characters ([#4109](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4109) )
- fix(api): Return 422 for deeply nested invalid request bodies ([#4108](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4108) )
- fix(api): Return 4xx for missing secrets, workflows and Bitbucket hosts ([#4163](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4163) )


**Full Changelog** :[1.5.0-alpha.2...1.5.0-alpha.2.1](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/compare/1.5.0-alpha.2...1.5.0-alpha.2.1)
